question: It was stated that experience points are dependent on the body, so Subaru can’t use Return by Death to become stronger, but does Ros-chi also reset his experience points when he changes bodies? It seems odd that long-lived Roswaal can’t use healing magic, but is it a problem not of experience, but of aptitude?
answer: Roswaal’s magic is a problem of aptitude. Also, experience points don’t reset in his case. Subaru really has no talent. Not even a little.
